title: Kiosk schema descriptor
description: The value of the kind:"value" envelope returned by GET /kiosk/schema.

verbs.description: The invariant four verbs (query, run, pay, schema), always all present -- the protocol surface itself, NOT the served subset. The served subset is `capabilities` in /.well-known/kiosk.json.

description.description: Human-facing description or null. Semantics live here in prose -- the AI assistant reads it.

params.description: Free-form provider-defined hint object (by convention name -> type-hint string), or null. Documentation, not a validation contract.

input_schema.description: OPTIONAL JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for THIS verb's inputs: required/optional, types, enums, ranges. Supersedes the free-text `params` hint for machine validation; `params` is kept alongside for prose/back-compat. Absent = no machine input contract published for this verb.

example_params.description: OPTIONAL example params object an AI assistant can copy verbatim as a starting call for this verb.

example_row.description: OPTIONAL example of one result element -- a representative row for a query, or the example return value for an action -- so an assistant learns the result shape without a call-and-observe probe.
